description: This file defines core classes, data structures, and functions related to guard mechanisms in PyTorch's TorchDynamo, including guard creation, guard source types, guard context management, checkpointing, and fake tensor detection.

classes.name: CompileId
classes.description: Represents a unique program-level identifier for compiled graphs, with methods for string serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: TraceId
classes.description: A tuple combining CompileId and an attempt counter, used for tracing analysis.

classes.name: GuardSource
classes.description: Enumeration of different guard source types, such as local, global, specialized modules, constants, etc.

classes.name: GuardBuilderBase
classes.description: Base class representing a scope for building guards.

classes.name: SLoc
classes.description: Stores source location information, including framework location and optional user location.

classes.name: ShapeGuard
classes.description: Represents a shape guard with a symbolic boolean expression, source location, and size-oblivious flag.

classes.name: Guard
classes.description: Represents a guard object with methods for creation, comparison, export, and execution.

classes.name: GuardEnvExpr
classes.description: Base class for guard environment expressions.

classes.name: DuplicateInputs
classes.description: Guard environment expression representing duplicate input positions.

classes.name: StorageOverlap
classes.description: Guard environment expression representing storage overlap relations among inputs.

classes.name: Checkpointable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can snapshot and restore state.

classes.name: GuardsCheckpointState
classes.description: Snapshot state for guards, supporting diffing and equality.

classes.name: ModuleContextCheckpointState
classes.description: Snapshot state for module context, supporting diffing and equality.

classes.name: ModuleContext
classes.description: Manages module state and supports copying/restoring graph state.

classes.name: GlobalContextCheckpointState
classes.description: Snapshot state for global context, supporting diffing and equality.

classes.name: GlobalContext
classes.description: Tracks global torch state during tracing, supports copying and restoring state.

classes.name: GuardsSet
classes.description: A set-like collection of guards that records user stacks.

classes.name: GuardsContext
classes.description: Checkpointable collection of guards in the current tracing context.

classes.name: HopSubgraphCache
classes.description: Abstract base class for caching subgraph-related data.

classes.name: InvokeSubgraphCache
classes.description: Concrete implementation of HopSubgraphCache, caching submodules, autograd keys, proxy dispatch, lazy backward graphs, and effects.

classes.name: HopDispatchSetCache
classes.description: Manages cache for higher-order operator dispatch sets.

classes.name: TracingContext
classes.description: Holds current tracing state, including guards, module, global context, and source location info.

classes.name: compile_context
classes.description: Context manager for setting the current compile context.

classes.name: tracing
classes.description: Context manager for setting the current tracing context.

classes.name: dataclass_with_cached_hash
classes.description: Decorator to create dataclasses with cached __hash__ for deterministic caching.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Base class for source objects used in guard creation, with methods for value evaluation and guard creation.

classes.name: ChainedSource
classes.description: Source subclass that chains another source, supporting recursive attribute evaluation.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Creates a CompileId from its string representation.

methods.name: inner_create_fn
methods.description: Returns the core create function, unwrapped if partial.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Executes the guard's creation function with a given builder.

methods.name: set_export_info
methods.description: Exports guard information such as type, class, code, and weakref.

methods.name: copy_graphstate
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current state.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current TracingContext, raising if none is active.

methods.name: try_get
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the current TracingContext, returning None if not set.

methods.name: extract_stack
methods.description: Extracts the current call stack as a traceback.StackSummary.

methods.name: set_current_loc
methods.description: Sets the current source location in the tracing context.
